trades.closedTradesCount: {count, plural, one {# closed trade} other {# closed trades}}
trades.comparableCount: {shown} of {count, plural, one {# closed trade} other {# closed trades}} comparable
trades.excursionNote: Gross excursion estimates; net P&L after fees
trades.explorerEmptyTitle: No closed trades in this selection
trades.explorerEmptyBody: Change the date range or filters to explore your history. Open positions are excluded.
trades.blockedCurrencies: These trades use different currencies ({currencies}). Select accounts with one currency for monetary axes, or use Duration and Realized R to compare risk-normalized outcomes. No currency conversion is applied.
trades.excludedNoteR: {count, plural, one {One trade excluded:} other {# trades excluded:}} realized R requires a valid planned stop-loss and any required contract multiplier; Both axes require valid values and timestamps.
trades.excludedNoteEstimates: {count, plural, one {One trade excluded:} other {# trades excluded:}} MAE/MFE require saved, current market-data estimates. Both axes require valid values and timestamps.
trades.excludedNotePlain: {count, plural, one {One trade excluded:} other {# trades excluded:}} Both axes require valid values and timestamps.
trades.excludedNoteBoth: {count, plural, one {One trade excluded:} other {# trades excluded:}} realized R requires a valid planned stop-loss and any required contract multiplier; MAE/MFE require saved, current market-data estimates. Both axes require valid values and timestamps.
trades.rExplainer: R = net P&L ÷ planned risk from your stop-loss. Uses weighted entry and total entry quantity; it does not measure maximum intratrade risk.
trades.inspectPointHint: Select a point to inspect its trade. Overlapping points remain individually accessible in the table.
trades.noAxisData: No trades have the data required for these axes. Try another axis or adjust your filters.
trades.tooFewPoints: Fewer than 8 comparable trades. Review the exact values below, or widen your filters to reveal a useful scatter plot.
trades.smallSample: Small sample: treat apparent patterns cautiously until more trades are available.
trades.exploreAll: Explore all {count, plural, one {# trade} other {# trades}}
trades.explorerTableCaption: All {count, plural, one {# comparable trade} other {# comparable trades}}, newest close first. Each link opens the original trade.
trades.durationFootnote: Duration is elapsed time from first entry to final exit, including overnight hours. Entry time uses the journal timezone; midnight neighbors appear at opposite ends of that axis. Patterns describe this selection, not causation or a recommended holding time.
